start: A gym member with several logged workouts and at least one new best, on Profile

user_sees: Screen titled 'Records'
Subtitle like '<n> lifts up · 12 records, newest first'
Month headings (for example 'September 2026') with record rows under them
must_not: A record missing from the list
Records in the wrong month or not newest first

user_sees: Exercise name, a record badge (for example best weight), the record value and its date with year
must_not: A value in the wrong unit
A blank value

user_sees: The exercise page of that exercise opens
must_not: A different exercise opening
The app closing

user_sees: The Records list again, at the same place
must_not: Records list reloading as empty

start: A gym member on Profile, a span card such as 'the last 30 days' says it has 14 new bests

steps.action: Tap 'See all 14' on the span card
user_sees: Screen 'Records' with subtitle ending ' in the last 30 days · 14 records, newest first'
Exactly the 14 records of that span
must_not: Records from outside the span
A count different from the card's '14'

user_sees: Button 'See all <total> records'
must_not: The button shown when the span already holds every record

user_sees: Every record, with month headings
must_not: The span label still in the subtitle

start: A gym member on Profile, Your lifts

user_sees: Screen 'Any exercise', subtitle 'See its trend on your Profile'
The exercise list with search, recent first, muscle and gear filters
must_not: An empty list when exercises exist

steps.action: Search an exercise and tap 'Show trend'
user_sees: Back on Profile with that exercise's trend shown
must_not: A second Profile screen stacked
The trend of a different exercise

steps.action: Tap the same exercise twice fast
user_sees: One pick, one step back
must_not: The app going back past Profile

start: A new gym member who has never beaten a best, or whose records cannot be read

user_sees: Empty state 'No records yet' with 'Beat a previous best and it lands here.'
must_not: A blank screen or an endless grey loading list
'No records yet' when the read failed

steps.action: Open Records when the read of records fails
user_sees: 'Couldn't load your records' with a try-again button
must_not: 'No records yet' shown for a failed read

steps.action: Tap try again after the problem clears
user_sees: The list of records
must_not: The error staying after a good read

start: A gym member with records, opening a span that has no new bests

steps.action: Open Records for a span with none, for example 'September 2026'
user_sees: 'No new bests in September 2026'
Button 'See all records'
must_not: 'No records yet' when other records exist

user_sees: Every record
must_not: The empty state staying

steps.action: Leave, finish a workout with a new best, come back to Records
user_sees: The new record at the top, under this month's heading
must_not: The new record missing until the app is restarted

steps.action: Delete that workout from its page, come back to Records
user_sees: That record gone; the earlier best is the record again
must_not: A record still shown for a deleted workout

start: A gym member whose gym has trainers, with 'Share my workouts with my trainers' off

user_sees: Own records only, all free
must_not: A paywall or lock on records or history
Another member's records

steps.action: Check who else sees the records
user_sees: Nothing in Records is sent anywhere by opening it
must_not: Records reaching the gym while sharing is off
